title: Baa Juice Mango Passionfruit Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Mango Passionfruit Ice combines the sunny sweetness of ripe Mango with the tangy, exotic notes of Passionfruit, finished with a refreshing burst of menthol. This tropical-inspired e-liquid delivers a bold and uplifting vape, ideal for fans of fruity blends with a frosty edge. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile, replicating the rich and intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Mango Passionfruit Ice offers a more economical and sustainable option for use with refillable vape devices.
